description: This PHP abstract class defines a base controller for handling file responses, including generating file responses, setting HTTP headers for file downloads, and managing content disposition and cache controls within a web application's framework.

classes.name: AbstractFileController
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common functionality for file download controllers, including response creation and HTTP header management.

methods.name: getNewFileResponse
methods.description: Creates a new BinaryFileResponse object for the specified file.

methods.name: getFileResponse
methods.description: Returns a cached BinaryFileResponse if available, or creates a new one for the specified file.

methods.name: makeAttachmentDisposition
methods.description: Generates a Content-Disposition header value for file attachment with proper encoding.

methods.name: setCommonHeadersToResponse
methods.description: Sets standard headers on the response object to facilitate file download, including content type, length, disposition, and cache control.
